### Inspected Sources
- [`SingleExtension.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/SingleExtension.lean)
- [`OppositeGQ35SpreadGeneric.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ35SpreadGeneric.lean)
- [`OppositeGQ35SpreadDefinitions.lean`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OppositeGQ35SpreadDefinitions.lean)
*Missing sources*: None. All tables and definitions are entirely self-contained.

### Translation

1. **Domains & Label Equivalence**:
   - $V = \text{Old} \oplus \text{New} = \text{Fin } 6144 \oplus \text{Fin } 16$ ($|V| = 6160$).
   - Coordinates: $\text{Old} \simeq \text{Point} \times \text{Line} = \text{Fin } 64 \times \text{Fin } 96$ with $u \mapsto (p_u, l_u)$ where $\text{val}(u) = l_u + 96 p_u$.
   - `label`: Canonical sum bijection $V \simeq \text{Fin } 6160$ ($0..6143$ for Old, $6144..6159$ for New).

2. **Adjacency**:
   - $\text{Inc}(p, l) \iff \exists i \in \text{Fin } 4, \text{linePointData}[4l + i] \pmod{64} = p$.
   - **Old–Old** ($u, v$): $u \neq v \land \text{Inc}(p_u, l_v) \land \text{Inc}(p_v, l_u)$ (cross-incidence of point and line coordinates).
   - **Old–New** ($u, j$): $\text{Inc}(p_u, l_u) \land \text{Inc}(p_u, \langle j, \dots \rangle)$ (requires flag incidence in $u$ and incidence of $p_u$ on line $j$).
   - **New–New**: `False` (independent set).

3. **Walk Bound & Proposed Target (`FinalClaim`)**:
   - `DiameterAtMost G D`: $\forall x, y \in V, \exists p : G.\text{Walk } x\ y, p.\text{length} \le D$.
   - Statement: $|V| = 6160 \land (\forall v \in V, \text{deg}(v) \le 24) \land \text{diam}(G) \le 3 \land \neg(\text{diam}(G) \le 2)$.

4. **Premises & Vacuity**:
   - Quantifiers span 6160 explicit vertices (no empty-domain vacuity).
   - No hidden certificate premises, axioms, or preconditions; `FinalClaim` is an unproved, closed proposition definition.
